The young man stands at the cliff edge with his back to us, gazing out over the vast layered mountains. The dawn mist drifts slowly across the distant peaks as a soft wind lifts the hem of his robe and a few strands of his hair. The camera pushes in gently and steadily toward him, the far sea horizon glowing faintly at the edge of the frame. Warm golden dawn light spreads softly across the scene, calm and expansive, with only the quiet sound of wind moving through the open air.

The young man kept singing as his gaze drifted slowly toward the front camera. His lips and jaw moved naturally to the rhythm, his brows relaxed, and he blinked gently between lines of the song. Amid the hazy background, scattered fallen leaves and soft warm light spots drifted lazily. The camera, with subtle shakiness typical of handheld shooting, circled around him steadily and slowly, gradually revealing his full face. Warm golden light outlined his profile, set against the cool shadows behind him, and his singing voice was calm yet brimming with sincere emotion.
